dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, have you found the adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Not yet. No adeptus has come to give me back my axe, either. How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: I did in fact pick up a sword.

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: But... I don't know how to use swords! Did the adeptus get something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Why don't you take this sword with you? I still need to wait for my axe to come back...

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Are you a traveler? ...Did you see my axe on your way here?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm a lumberjack, I work in this area. But I lost my axe — again.

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Maybe I misplaced it when I stopped to take a break?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: But if it's genuinely lost, then as the legend says, an adeptus should bring it back to me...

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: If that's the case... Maybe it would be quicker if I went looking for the adeptus instead?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: I've searched this entire area up and down looking for my axe, but I haven't seen a thing...
